title: What Each Wellness Membership Tier Includes: Gym, Pool and Member Services
content:
Each Wellness Membership tier opens the clinic gym, the pool or both, and the higher tiers add movement screens, performance analyses, group classes, guest visits and a package discount.

| Tier | Clinic gym in open-gym hours | Pool in open-swim hours at aquatic clinics | Movement screens per calendar year | Running or golf performance analyses per calendar year | Group exercise classes per billing period | Guest visits per billing period | Discount on a Self-Pay Visit Package |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open Gym Access Membership | Yes | No | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0% |
| Aquatic Access Membership | No | Yes | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0% |
| Wellness Essentials Membership | Yes | No | 0 | 0 | 2 | 0 | 5% |
| Wellness Plus Membership | Yes | Yes | 1 | 0 | 4 | 1 | 10% |
| Performance Membership | Yes | No | 1 | 2 | 8 | 2 | 10% |
| Performance Plus Membership | Yes | Yes | 2 | 4 | 8 | 4 | 15% |

## Terms used in this section

- **Gym** means the clinic gym during open-gym hours; **pool** means the pool during open-swim hours at the clinics that have one.
- **Movement screens** and **performance analyses** are counted per calendar year; **group classes** and **guest visits** are counted per billing period.
- **Discount on a Self-Pay Visit Package** is the percentage discount on a Self-Pay Visit Package bought while the membership is active.

## Questions the table answers

**Which tiers include the pool?** The Aquatic Access Membership, the Wellness Plus Membership and the Performance Plus Membership.

**Which tiers include both the gym and the pool?** The Wellness Plus Membership and the Performance Plus Membership.

**Which tier includes the pool but not the gym?** The Aquatic Access Membership.

**Which tiers include performance analyses?** The Performance Membership (2 per calendar year) and the Performance Plus Membership (4 per calendar year).

**Which tiers include guest visits?** The Wellness Plus Membership (1 per billing period), the Performance Membership (2) and the Performance Plus Membership (4).

**What package discount does each tier carry?** 0% on the two access tiers, 5% on the Wellness Essentials Membership, 10% on the Wellness Plus Membership and the Performance Membership, and 15% on the Performance Plus Membership.
